thread:
Alex: kicking off Fairbanks region prep — small note: customer asked for lower-latency endpoints for AK users, and legal asked about egress/residency. Can owners confirm feasibility and rough cost delta?
Maya: @Alex I can take legal/residency check (Maya). Will confirm if data residency rules force us to keep logs in-region or just control egress. ETA EOD Thu.
Li: I can own KMS + key policies for Fairbanks. Quick question: is the target region `us-north-1` or a partner colo? need to know for KMS availability.
Samir: Terraform PR up: infra/regions/fairbanks/ — added VPC, subnets, NATs. Still missing route53 failover and egress policy. Pinged in the PR for review: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4823
Anna: I can do oncall for the 1-week post-cutover window. Also can run canary smoke tests.
Alex: thanks. @Samir can you paste the routing policy we plan to use? want to make sure cross-region fallback is explicit.
Samir: routing snippet below — this is the minimal policy for preferring AK-edge then fallback to lwm-edge (low-cost west).
```
route_policy:
  prefer: [ak-edge, lwm-edge]
  fallbacks:
    - region: lwm-edge
      max_latency_ms: 250
      cost_pref: high
  egress: restrict-to-owned-nats
```
Li: KMS note: if this is standard AWS KMS in us-north-1, we can mirror CMKs with multi-region keys, but that adds cost and cross-region replication complexity. Alternative: customer-managed HSM in the colo — bigger ops burden.
Maya: Legal note: if we keep any PII in logs, residency may require storing logs within AK jurisdiction. If it's just inference metadata (no PII) then standard egress controls suffice. I'll confirm exact wording with privacy counsel.
Anna: On the canary side, what traffic split are we doing? 1% for 48h?
Alex: proposal: 0.5% for 24h, then 2% for 48h if no regressions. Canary will hit the fairbanks-canary pool and compare latency and failure rates vs nws-edge baseline.
infra-bot: canary pipeline created: pipeline/fairbanks-canary (ID: cb-7742). Auto-rollback: false.
deploy-bot: rolled out test image to fairbanks-canary (image: rwd-infer:canary-202378). Logs at /var/logs/canary/fairbanks/
Li: Quick infrastructure ask for reviewers: need an explicit KMS policy and a terraform var for key_arn. I'll add to the PR tomorrow morning.
Samir: routing docs updated with the policy above and a note about cost tradeoffs. Added cost estimate: +8-12% token egress cost (rough) due to replicated cache misses, see spreadsheet: https://sheets.internal/fairbanks-costs
Maya: action: I'll confirm residency constraints (owner: Maya).
Li: action: KMS plan + PR update (owner: Li).
Samir: action: finish route53 failover + mark PR ready (owner: Samir).
Anna: action: create canary test plan and dashboards (owner: Anna).
Alex: target milestones — PR merged by Tue EOD, canary start Wed, canary review Thu-Fri, go/no-go by next Mon. If any blocker, flag here.
Maya: noted. I'll escalate to privacy counsel if needed.
Anna: small FR: can we get an additional token-level latency metric in the canary dashboard? currently only request latency percentiles.
Alex: yes, @Anna work with observability (tag: #eng-sre) — or ping me and I'll intro.
Samir: pinging @Tom from eng-sre on the PR for dashboards.
Tom: (joined) I can add token-level metric. Give me the canary group name and sample traces.
Anna: group is fairbanks-canary, sample trace id: trace-fb-33 (from deploy-bot logs).
Alex: thanks everyone. I'll summarise owners in the PR and set the milestone. If we hit any KMS/legal hardblocks we postpone the canary.
Maya: quick FYI — privacy counsel prefers a short writeup rather than long doc. I'll attach to the PR when done.
Alex: closing loop for now. Reopen thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
